name: Quick Convert
author: Dante Regis
description: Type a conversion or a sum, get the answer. Currencies with live rates, length, mass, volume, temperature, speed, area, data, time, and plain arithmetic.

barWidget.description: A single input box: "100 EUR in BRL", "10 km to mi", "3 * 14", "(54 * 12) BRL in USD". Enter copies the result.

schema.label: Default target currency
schema.description: ISO code used when you type an amount and a currency but no target, e.g. "100 EUR". "auto" follows the system locale.

schema.label: Secondary target currency
schema.description: Used instead when the source already is the default target currency.

schema.label: Unit system
schema.description: Decides the partner for units outside both systems: nautical miles go to km or miles, knots to km/h or mph, kelvin to °C or °F.

schema.label: Number format
schema.description: auto = system locale, point = 1,234.56, comma = 1.234,56, space = 1 234,56, plain = 1234.56. Also decides how a lone separator in your input is read.

schema.label: Exchange-rate refresh
schema.description: The provider publishes once a day; "provider" refetches right after its announced update time. The hour options re-download at a fixed interval instead.
